raw_text: Press Release — Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India, May 4, 2023. The Ministry of Home Affairs has taken cognizance of the deteriorating law and order situation in the state of Manipur. The following measures have been taken: (1) Deployment of additional 40 companies of Central Armed Police Forces including CRPF and BSF; (2) Appointment of a Special Secretary-level officer to coordinate relief and security operations; (3) Direction to the state government to ensure protection of life and property of all communities; (4) Establishment of a 24-hour control room at MHA for coordination. The Home Minister has spoken with the Governor and Chief Minister of Manipur. The government is committed to restoring peace and normalcy at the earliest.
